What changed in this PR This PR addresses #26907 by updating MLflow’s Anthropic gateway streams to use final input and cache token counts reported in `message_delta`. **Changes:** - Collect input and cache counts from both streaming usage events in passthrough responses. - Update chat streaming usage with final counts while preserving omitted fields. - Add regression tests for final token counts in both streaming paths. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​gateway/​providers/​test_anthropic.py` | Adds passthrough and chat streaming tests for final usage counts. | | `mlflow/​gateway/​providers/​anthropic.py` | Reads final input/cache counts from deltas and shares passthrough extraction logic. |

review_comments.body:
**🐛 Issue:** When `message_delta` updates input tokens but omits cache counts, passthrough normalization loses the earlier cache contribution. A start event with 100 input and 25 cache-read tokens followed by a separate delta with 120 input tokens records 120 instead of 145, producing incorrect span usage and cost.

**🔧 Fix:** Merge raw input/cache counts in per-stream state before normalizing, preserving omitted fields, and add regression coverage for partial delta updates.
